claims.text: Most esophageal CA (T2 or higher, or any nodal involvement): chemoradiation before surgical resection
claims.quote: However, most esophageal cancers (T2 or higher, or any nodal involvement) are treated with combination chemotherapy and radiation (chemoradiation) before surgical resection
Most commonly, cisplatin and 5-fluorouracil are used in combination.

claims.text: Residual dz after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and resection: postoperative immunotherapy
claims.quote: Following neoadjuvant chemoradiation and then surgical resection, patients with residual disease receive postoperative immunotherapy (2).

claims.text: Nivolumab after surgery, added to neoadjuvant chemoradiation, improved survival vs placebo
claims.quote: Another study showed that after surgery, immunotherapy (with nivolumab) added to neoadjuvant chemoradiation improved survival more than placebo (2).
